author: reek
body: The unified component model. A component in Codex Circuits is not split across separate symbol, footprint, and model libraries like traditional EDA tools. A single ComponentDef carries everything: schematic symbol geometry, PCB footprint pads, 3D model reference, SPICE simulation model, and supply chain data.

author: reek
body: A placed component in a design. Carries its reference designator, variant overrides, and placement coordinates.
